title: Spex Machina Task State Artifact
description: Schema for the task-state artifact plan reads through its required --tasks flag: the versioned document an adapter's export half derives from the tracker, listing in-flight work only. There is no closed status and no way to express one — a task absent from the document has no live work.

version.description: The task-state format version. Required and refused if not exactly 1 — this document is regenerated from the tracker before every run, so a consumer refuses what it does not speak rather than guessing at the entry shape.

tasks.description: In-flight tasks only. An empty array is a legal, explicit nothing-in-flight statement, not a degenerate case.

task_id.description: The tracker's own id for the task — the same value a receipt's task_id and a journal receipt's task_id carry.

status.description: Exactly two values. There is no closed, no done, and no third status — completion is derived from the journal pairing plus the task's absence from this document, never carried as a status.
